name: Maya
headline: Michigan econ + music minor who turns sports and music data into decisions; wants a well-paid analytics role in NYC.

priorities.label: Location
priorities.preference: New York City (Brooklyn/Jersey City fine). Not remote-only. Other cities only for a dream job.

priorities.label: Compensation

priorities.label: Industry
priorities.preference: Sports or music first; media and ticketing/live-events tech also good.
